judge.rationale: The candidate correctly removes the `instanceof Error` gate in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, wraps non-Error rejections with `{cause: error}`, rethrows the original value, and updates both `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. All acceptance criteria are satisfied, though notice that the plain object test in `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` doesn't explicitly assert on `seenError.cause === reason` (unlike its string and undefined tests), even though the production code sets it unconditionally. Compared to the reference, which adds a single parameterized test to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and uses `JSON.stringify` for a more informative error message on plain objects, the candidate uses `String(error)` (yielding `[object Object]`) and scatters tests across five new files (`onErrorCause.test.ts`, `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`, `onErrorTestFixtures.ts`, `onErrorUndefined.test.ts`, `onErrorUnstringifiable.test.ts`) plus `.lore/dod.md`. Additionally, in the new test files, the candidate uses bare `// eslint-disable-next-line require-yield` without an explanation comment, which may fail `eslint --max-warnings 0` if `eslint-comments/require-description` is enabled as seen in the reference diff.
